dedupe_keys.name: epias transparency platform turkish electricity and natural gas market generation consumption and outage data

description: The EPİAŞ Transparency Platform (Şeffaflık Platformu) is run by EPİAŞ, the Turkish energy markets operator, and publishes electricity and natural gas market information, with separate electricity and natural gas sections; version 2.0 went live in December 2023. In February 2020 EPİAŞ added distribution company data under consumption, namely planned and unplanned outage information, consumer numbers and consumption quantities, noting that pages would be completed as distribution companies finished integration. In March 2024 it released updated web services for electricity data, natural gas data and electricity market reports, stating that IP registration is no longer needed; the technical guide explains that data shown to logged-in users need authentication with a ticket-granting ticket from the EPİAŞ login service. Coverage is Turkey. Data are free to view on the website and to download as JSON through the web services; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the website renders in the browser, so only the announcements and service guide were read, and outage data depend on each distribution company. Simulation uses are Turkish demand, generation and market inputs for grid and gas models and distribution outage statistics. Related records: data-entsoe-transparency-platform is the European counterpart.
